problem_statement:
Request with binary payload fails due to calling to_native_string
Introduced with https://github.com/kennethreitz/requests/issues/2844

```
import requests
requests.put("http://httpbin.org/put", data=u"ööö".encode("utf-8"))
```

This works with 2.8.1, but not with 2.9.
public_checks:
python -c 'from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import parse_qs
import requests
assert Path(requests.__file__).resolve().parent.parent == Path.cwd().resolve(), "must test frozen checkout"
url = "http://example.invalid/upload"
for text in ("normal text", "caf\u00e9"):
    prepared = requests.Request("PUT", url, data=text).prepare()
    assert prepared.body == text and isinstance(prepared.body, str)
prepared = requests.Request("POST", url, data={"a": "1", "b": "two words"}).prepare()
assert parse_qs(prepared.body) == {"a": ["1"], "b": ["two words"]}
assert prepared.headers["Content-Type"] == "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
prepared = requests.Request("POST", url, data=[("x", "1"), ("x", "2")]).prepare()
assert parse_qs(prepared.body) == {"x": ["1", "2"]}
prepared = requests.Request("POST", url, data=None).prepare()
assert prepared.body is None and prepared.headers["Content-Length"] == "0"
prepared = requests.Request("GET", url, params={"q": "text"}).prepare()
assert prepared.url.endswith("?q=text")
print("offline text and form compatibility passed")
'

python -c 'from pathlib import Path
import requests
assert Path(requests.__file__).resolve().parent.parent == Path.cwd().resolve(), "must test frozen checkout"
payloads = (
    "\u00f6\u00f6\u00f6".encode("utf-8"),
    b"\x00\xff\x80\xfe",
    bytes(range(256)),
    b"plain ascii bytes",
)
for method in ("PUT", "POST"):
    for payload in payloads:
        prepared = requests.Request(method, "http://example.invalid/upload", data=payload,
                                    headers={"Content-Type": "application/octet-stream"}).prepare()
        assert isinstance(prepared.body, bytes), "binary body must remain bytes"
        assert prepared.body == payload, "binary payload was changed"
        assert prepared.headers["Content-Length"] == str(len(payload))
        assert prepared.headers["Content-Type"] == "application/octet-stream"
        assert prepared.method == method
print("offline binary payload contract passed")
'
